_comment: Game-defined jutsu and sign sequences. These are original game configurations, not canonical sequences from any series. Edit freely (or use the editor in the Jutsu Library). Rules: 1-6 signs (a single sign works only if no other sequence starts with it), no sequence may be the beginning of another, no sign twice in a row.

jutsu.name: Fireball Jutsu
jutsu.subtitle: Fire Style
jutsu.description: Gather heat behind the breath and release it as a roaring sphere of flame that swells as it travels.

jutsu.name: Water Style
jutsu.subtitle: Rising Tide
jutsu.description: Draw moisture from the air into a surging wave that crashes across the arena and breaks into spray.

jutsu.name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
jutsu.subtitle: Many From One
jutsu.description: Freeze the moment and split into smoke-born doubles of yourself: the clones are copied from your live camera image the instant you form Ram.

jutsu.name: Transformation Jutsu
jutsu.subtitle: Change of Form
jutsu.description: Vanish inside a burst of shimmering smoke and re-emerge wearing a different shape.

jutsu.name: Lightning Style
jutsu.subtitle: Storm Lance
jutsu.description: Charge the air until it splits, sending jagged bolts racing down in a series of blinding flashes.

jutsu.name: Wind Style
jutsu.subtitle: Cutting Gale
jutsu.description: Compress a gust into ribbons of slicing air that sweep the arena in a tightening spiral.

jutsu.name: Earth Style
jutsu.subtitle: Stone Rampart
jutsu.description: Strike the ground with your will and raise a wall of jagged stone pillars from beneath the dust.

jutsu.name: Spiral Sphere
jutsu.subtitle: Rasengan-style Energy Attack
jutsu.description: Spin raw energy into a dense, howling sphere, hold it steady in orbiting light, then let it burst outward.
